entities.summary: Porta coeli is a 13th-century convent located in Předklášteří, near Tišnov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic. Situated in the valley of the Svratka River, this Cistercian convent was founded in 1233 by Queen Constance of Hungary. A granddaughter of Raynald of Châtillon, and the widow of King Ottokar I of Bohemia, Queen Constance was also buried at Porta coeli.
